Glencraig is a charming three-bedroom semi-detached residence situated in one of Dundalk`s most established and sought-after residential locations.

Extending to approximately 95 sq. m. this property offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout and presents an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a home with superb potential in a mature residential setting.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious front sitting room with attractive bay window, separate living/dining room, kitchen and utility room. Upstairs there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, a shower room and separate WC.

While the property would benefit from modernisation and upgrading it offers tremendous scope for improvement and allows the successful purchaser the opportunity to create a home tailored to their own tastes and requirements. Offering generous proportions throughout, a practical floor plan and , a prime residential setting this property provides exceptional potential for refurbishment and future value enhancement.
